sentences.text:
Rishav Sinha & Anr vs The State Of West Bengal & Anr on 2
December, 2025
02.12.2025
Ct. No.42
D/L 20
Mujahid
 Crr 3795 of 2025
 Rishav Sinha & Anr.
 Vs.
 The State of West Bengal & Anr.
 Mr. Prosenjit Mukherjee
 Mr. Prosenjit Chongder
Present petition has been filed for quashing of criminal proceeding arising out of charge-sheet No.57 of 2024 dated 19th February, 2024 under Sections 498A/506/34 of the IPC qua the petition.
2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that against the petitioners only the charge-sheet under Sections 498A/506/34 of the IPC has been filed.
Learned counsel further submits that the father of the petitioners Birendra Kumar Sinha had taken premises on rent from Baby Saha as per the tenancy agreement filed along with the petition.
Learned counsel submits that Mr. Soumya Saha son of Babi Saha landlord of the house is the principal accused against whom the complaint was made by his wife.
Learned counsel submits that petitioner nos.1 and 2 are both highly educated persons and have nothing to do with the matrimonial dispute between the son of the landlord and his wife.
Learned counsel submits that if the petitioners are made to suffer the trial, their carrier will be ruined.

3. Issue notice to the State of West Bengal through the office of the learned Public Prosecutor.
Opposite party no.2
5. State is directed to produce the case diary.
